plugins: networkCommands exact GET authorization + default public Node transport
loopback-network.policy: Exact URL/GET authorization at each call; fixed server does not redirect. Supported positive limit defaults do not promise zero redirect count.

transportPolicy.transport: node:http GET; fixed local server only; no implementation replacement

delta.diagnosticPolicy: All seven predeclared diagnostics run on both engines; never inflate positive primary counts. Initial five retained in attempt-001.

Use supported positive curl limits with exact-URL authorization
Main-thread-only module trace, not inherited worker preload
Canonical /tmp -> /private/tmp loaded-path audit; same snapshot bytes

loaderBinding.trace: registered in main child only; baseline workers retain default execArgv, no inherited audit preload

comparisonPolicy.expected: Predetermined workflow intent, not native captures. Exact status/byte fields and declared includes/excludes, file requirements, input content/type/mode preservation. No equality credit for both failing.
comparisonPolicy.metadata: Raw all available fields retained. Stable effects use path,type,permission bits, regular-file bytes, symlink target. Dates, opaque identity, inode/device allocation and directory sizes not cross-engine equality fields.
comparisonPolicy.namespace: Full root census including fixture/tmp/infrastructure; all effects listed. Fixture mode differences remain visible. Input preservation ignores read-induced metadata timestamps, not content/mode/type.
comparisonPolicy.diagnostics: 7 reachability-only sub-attempts per engine; never primary positive coverage.
comparisonPolicy.timing: performance.now around product exec only; sleep lower-bound sanity only. No speed comparison.
comparisonPolicy.optionalSafejs: No installed legitimate runtime in allowed module roots per setup; no plugin registration with fake hooks; no compatible replacement for the four optional names.
